Class Loan

java.lang.Object
lms.domain.Loan
public class Loan extends Object
Represents a loan of a library item to a user.

Manages loan lifecycle including borrow dates, due dates, returns, and fine calculations based on item type.

Version:
2.0
Author:
Majd Awwad

    • Loan

      public Loan(UUID userId, UUID itemId, String itemType, LocalDate borrowDate)
      Creates a new loan for the specified user and item.
      Parameters:
      userId - the borrower's ID
      itemId - the item ID
      itemType - the item type (book, cd, journal)
      borrowDate - the borrow date
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any parameter is invalid
